title: [ROCm] FP8 _scaled_grouped_mm & BF16 _grouped_mm support
bug_description:
### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch

In the age of MoE, for inference & training, groupedgemm is one of the most important layers and takes any where from 60-70% of total wall time time/FLOPS.

ROCm is currently missing support FP8 `torch._scaled_grouped_mm` & BF16 `torch._grouped_mm`
 
+viz @qcolombet @japarada


### Alternatives

have a for loop over each expert and do an bmm for each one. incredibly slow 

### Additional context

_No response_

cc @ezyang @gchanan @zou3519 @kadeng @msaroufim @jeffdaily @sunway513 @jithunnair-amd @pruthvistony @ROCmSupport @dllehr-amd @jataylo @hongxiayang @naromero77amd
